allowedFields: process-ledger schema, ordinal, mode, processId, creationTimeUtc, exitedAtUtc, exitCode, state and identity-receipt binding
lane-receipt inputId, superblockId, anonymousLaneId, input binding, laneWallClockMilliseconds, createdAtUtc, completion state and structural row cardinalities
frozen input designRegion, seed, gridEdge G, agentCount N, changedCellCount F, topology and structural stratum
process-resource CPU, managed-memory, private-memory, working-set and peak-working-set structural samples
host, process and disk structural metadata
frozen schedule and named identity mapping only after the anonymous result has been written, hashed and made read-only
prohibitedFields: algorithm output observations or endpoint values
effect direction, formal contrasts, p-values, ranking, weighting or winner
qualification values used as formal scientific samples
timeDecompositionBoundary: Only process wall, inter-process gap and directly measured inclusive lane-body duration are identifiable. Inclusive lane body contains setup, planner work, oracle/cache use, instrumentation, resource sampling, serialization and raw writes. Pure algorithm compute, Unity startup and exit/finalization are not separately identifiable, and no residual may be relabeled as one of them.
